candidates.change_summary: Change burn to subtract from a different account's balance and totalSupply using target address 0 (burn reduces totalSupply but attempts to deduct from zero address causing different totalSupply result when caller has balance).
Change burn to only decrease caller's balance but forget to decrease totalSupply (totalSupply remains unchanged after burn).
Change burn to decrease totalSupply by double the value burned (over-decrement totalSupply).
Modify onlyOwner modifier to invert the ownership check (allow only non-owner), which can change whether burn can be called and thus whether totalSupply changes after burn.

Change burn to allow anyone (remove onlyOwner) so callers other than owner can reduce their own balance, affecting balanceOf(k) for caller or others if they pass different address (but here burn uses msg.sender).
Modify burn to subtract from totalSupply but not from the caller's balance, so balanceOf values remain larger after burn (totalSupply changes but balances do not).
Change burn to subtract the burned amount from a different account (owner) instead of msg.sender, altering balanceOf(k) for the owner when non-owner calls burn (if allowed by onlyOwner).
Change burn to require a different condition (require balanceOf[owner] >= _value) causing reversion or different allowed burns and thus different balances after successful calls.
Change onlyOwner helper function to invert the requirement, making it revert for the owner instead of others and affecting which callers can successfully call burn via the onlyOwner modifier.
